findings.source: RESULTS AND DISCUSSION - Qualitative Analysis – Surface Colours and Textures

limitations: Additional variables (contrasting room heights, window areas, construction years) may influence indoor environmental quality and compromise findings.
The thermal survey method could be more accurate with a predetermined and constant heat source.
The infrared camera used a global emissivity value (0.90) for all surfaces, neglecting material particularities, which may impact image analysis.
Analysis of visual ambiances should include subjective evaluation, not solely photographic and software analysis.
Further studies in different settings are necessary to confirm the observed trends in thermal and acoustic comfort parameters.
